name: ARMBench
summary: 在亚马逊仓库机器人拣放流程中采集的大规模物体中心基准，覆盖操作前、转运中和放置后的图像、视频与元数据，并提供分割、识别和缺陷检测标注。
summaryEn: A large object-centric benchmark captured during warehouse robotic pick-and-place, with images, videos, and metadata before picking, during transfer, and after placement.
scaleZh: 23.5 万余次拣放活动 · 19 万余个独特物体
license: Official code is Apache-2.0; dataset terms must be checked separately
licenseZh: 官方代码采用 Apache-2.0；数据条款需另行核验
access: Official dataset website and loading code available
accessZh: 提供官方数据网站和加载代码
wmNote: 连续操作阶段和大规模真实物体多样性有助于学习操作过程表征；公开任务主要聚焦感知而非控制策略。
wmNoteEn: Manipulation stages and large real-object diversity support process representations, though its published tasks focus mainly on perception rather than control policies.
